# About Stabull

Stabull is a 4th Generation decentralized automated money market (AMM), led by a consortium of vested stablecoin issuers, to securely, economically and efficiently facilitate permissionless dynamic stablecoin swaps within the crypto industry’s largest addressable market based off the industry’s most recent advancements.

The exponential growth in liquidity, users and use-cases currently underway in the stablecoin industry creates an opportunity to offer a common piece of infrastructure specific to issuer needs, while catering to respective communities.

Stabull.Finance defines the logic and delivers the means for stablecoin issuers to increase adoption and expand market opportunities with a 4th generation AMM.

![](https://stabull.finance/wp-content/uploads/2023/07/stabull-finance-image-1.jpg)

## Our core platform

Stabull is focused on providing the best experience in DeFi for Stablecoin Swaps from our portfolio of supported pairs. We focus on fiat backed stablecoins, enabling our traders to get easy and simple access to a range of currently supported stablecoins, as well as newly added pairs as the platform grows. We want to focus on this, and do it well, giving people who otherwise suffer from poor liquidity or high fees on established exchanges or dex’s a simple and efficient way to convert between stablecoins, as well as provide liquidity to our platform.

You can get more information on the platform, ecosystem and features by visiting our [Gitbook](https://docs.stabull.finance).
